hypotheses.name: Cross-model perturbation Jacobian alignment (multi-seed)
hypotheses.method: Multi-seed (seed42_main/seed43/seed44) run across immune/lung/external_lung; GO-module role vectors aligned between scGPT and Geneformer; perturbation panel used dropout/sign-flip/rewire across strengths {0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00}; measured response-rank Spearman and Jacobian-subspace cosine with nulls: perturbation-schedule permutation, module size/variance-matched shuffle, random gene mapping.
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this rescue endpoint and only revisit cross-model transfer with a materially different objective and immune-specific causal anchor.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Fail-fast criterion triggered: immune null-gap stayed negative across all three seeds; seed-level domain gate not met.

hypotheses.method: Seed42 run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits over layers {0,3,7,11}; state alphabet used TF-activity bin x support bin x sign-state, scored via second-order sequence likelihood, compared against deep-layer H70 baseline with nulls: state-frequency-matched token shuffle, layer-order permutation, label permutation.
